title: Phoenix · Apache Trail and Salt River
slogan: A 294 km loop out of Tortilla Flat
story: Desert light, canyon roads and heat discipline. A 294 km loop that starts and ends near Gold Canyon, about 5 h 04 of riding. It goes by way of Apache Trail overlook, Roosevelt Lake and Globe. The highest point is about 1,300 m. The plan has 1 food stop and 1 fuel stop marked.

sections.advice: Use Phoenix start → Tortilla Flat as clean positioning. Keep it tidy, ignore impatient traffic and save the enthusiasm for the good road ahead. The value here is not drama; it is arriving at the riding section with space, fuel and concentration intact.

This Roosevelt Lake → Globe fuel stretch is for rhythm and scenery. Keep your head up, let the view breathe, and resist turning every open bend into a target. Stop once properly rather than half-stopping everywhere.

scenicChapters.title: Apache Trail
scenicChapters.narrative: For 18 km this is Apache Trail, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it — expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast.

scenicChapters.title: Apache Trail
scenicChapters.narrative: Water arrives beside the road and stays for 45 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go. Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did.
